technical_and_design_decisions: Interpret the specification as describing an increment of Spring Cloud Data Flow (SCDF), since the user stories reference Mesos SPI, YARN deployer, Rabbit binder, Kafka bus, SHDP (Spring Hadoop) and SI (Spring Integration), which are SCDF components.
Treat each user story as a self-contained work item to be developed by a single developer, with light-weight design (where useful) followed by coding, unit tests and minimal integration verification.
Group version-bump stories (U4, U5, U7) into a single dependency-upgrade activity because they share similar mechanics (POM edits, API refactor handling, test fixes).
Apply small-scale optimizations to the YARN deployer (U3) such as packaging and submission refinements rather than a full architectural rewrite.
Use a single integration/system testing pass across all stories rather than per-story end-to-end suites, to keep the total effort realistic for one developer.
Document the HSQL DB limitations (U8) in the existing reference documentation under the composed-jobs section.
assumptions: The developer is fully familiar with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Integration, Spring Cloud, Spring XD/Data Flow).
A working local build environment (JDK 17+, Maven/Gradle, Mesos/YARN test cluster) is already provisioned; no environment setup effort is included.
Mesos, YARN, RabbitMQ, and Kafka test infrastructure are available for verification (no provisioning effort included).
Upstream artifact versions (SHDP 2.2.1, SI 4.2.2, Boot, Spring Cloud Build) are publicly available and require only POM/coordinate changes plus compatibility fixes.
No new public API is required for the Mesos undeployed status; existing status enum is extended.
The Rabbit REST API endpoint follows the existing controller/endpoint conventions of the SCDF REST layer; no new authentication model is introduced.
Kafka bus partitioning key change is backward compatible: when no key is set, current behavior is preserved.
HSQL DB composed-jobs documentation is based on already-known limitations (no deep investigation required).
A standard 8-hour workday is used for the effort unit.
Code review is assumed to be lightweight and covered within the implementation/test activity of each story.

activities.activity_name: Add undeployed status to Mesos SPI (U1)
activities.activity_description: Extend the Mesos deployer status enum with an UNDEPLOYED state, update status reporting/mapping logic, and add unit tests covering the new state transitions.
Add a REST controller endpoint that exposes the existing RabbitBindingCleaner, wire it into the SCDF REST API surface, and add controller/unit tests for the new endpoint.
Analyze the YARN application submission flow, apply optimizations (e.g., reduced packaging/submission overhead, parallelized steps where safe), and validate behavior with deploy/undeploy tests.
Update SHDP dependency coordinates to 2.2.1.GA, backport needed improvements, adjust Spring/Hadoop versions, and fix any compatibility breakages in build and code.
Bump SI version to 4.2.2.GA, resolve any deprecated/changed APIs used by the binders, and verify integration tests still pass.

activities.activity_name: Add partitioning key support for single downstream module on Kafka bus (U6)
activities.activity_description: Allow a partitioning key to be configured/used on the Kafka bus even when only one downstream module is present; update configuration plumbing and add tests for ordering/partitioning behavior.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions (U7)
activities.activity_description: Update Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build plugin/dependency revisions to the latest, regenerate/verify build output, and patch any breaking changes.

activities.activity_name: Document HSQL DB limitations for composed jobs (U8)
activities.activity_description: Write/extend the reference documentation describing HSQL DB limitations when used with composed jobs (e.g., concurrency, transaction semantics) and review for accuracy.
Run a full build and integration test suite covering the upgrade combinations and the new/changed features to ensure no regressions are introduced.

activities.activity_name: Release notes and final documentation updates
activities.activity_description: Update release notes, changelog, and any user-facing docs (e.g., REST API docs for the new Rabbit cleaner endpoint, configuration docs for the Kafka partitioning key).
Finalize version numbers, tag the release, perform a release build, and publish artifacts to the appropriate repository.
